name: archify
description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams; self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
one_liner: Ask your AI coding assistant to map a codebase and it produces a polished, interactive, shareable system diagram you can trust.
buyer: Engineering consultancies and solution architects who bill for 'we audited your system' and currently draw diagrams by hand for hours.
business_use_cases: A consultancy hands a client a clean, interactive architecture map as part of every technical audit deliverable.
A dev team auto-generates a before/after diagram for each big pull request so reviewers see structural changes at a glance.
A software vendor keeps its docs diagrams always current by regenerating them from the real code on every release.

money_ideas.idea: A paid 'diagram-as-a-service' that connects to a repo and keeps living architecture docs updated automatically.
Productized architecture audits for small companies, sold as a fixed-price report built on this.

steal_this: Offer startups a $500 'architecture health check': run this on their repo, deliver the interactive map plus a one-page risk summary.
